event: Airport passenger and baggage check-in closes
detail: General rule has exceptions for individual routes; current retrieved page does not establish an MRV-specific exception; minimum processing cutoff, not a recommended airport-arrival margin
FAQ says opens 2h before departure; carriage rules say begins no later than 2h before departure; this is opening time, not an airport-arrival recommendation
Section 9.1 requires gate arrival by time printed on boarding pass; no universal numeric boarding-close buffer recovered; do not substitute 20min
